Proteinuria 0.55g/day is described as the current state on maintenance therapy in the case text and as the result after six months of induction in the discussion, and the case text places the 9.7g/day peak after the reduction of immunosuppression.

Acne is placed "after one month on steroids" and "about a month after the initiation of steroids", but the patient was already taking steroids before presentation.
